features.name: Spellblade at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in one weapon types and a shield type, or two weapon types. Also gain Proficiencies in Light and Medium armor.

features.name: Siphoning Strike
features.body: Once per round when you defeat an enemy with a Melee Attack or a Melee Spell Attack, if you dealt magic damage with the attack, gain 1 Mana. Mana gained increases by +1 at Spellblade Levels 3, 6, and 9.

features.name: Smart Striking
features.body: You may use INT instead of STR or DEX for both Attack and Damage rolls with melee weapons you are proficient with. At Spellblade Level 9, use both INT+[STR or DEX] instead of either stat. You make Melee Spell Attacks from your melee weapon instead of your bare hands or spell foci.

features.name: Quick Enchant: Melee
features.body: You may cast Enchant Weapon - Melee spells as an Extra Action.

features.name: Prolonged Enchantment: Melee
features.body: When enchanting a melee weapon, instead of it lasting a number of attacks, you may have it last **3 turns** instead. The number of turns increases by **+1** at Spellblade Level 8, and Player Level 16.

features.name: Spellstrike Points & Abilities
features.body:
Gain maximum **Spellstrike Points** equal to your *Spellblade Level*. These points reset to full after a Short or Long Rest and can be used on various Spellstrike abilities. All Spellstrike abilities deal Magical damage.

Gain **+2** Spellstrike Points at the start of combat, up to your maximum. This increases by **+1** at Spellblade Levels 6 and 9, as well as Player Levels 13 and 17. Choose **2 Spellstrike** abilities readied that you have access to during combat.

The maximum number of readied Spellstrike abilities learned increases by +1 at Spellblade Levels 5, 7 and 9. Use a Long or Short Rest Action to swap any number of Spellstrike Abilities out with the others.

features.name: Signature Spells: Spellblade
features.body: Gain access to Spellblade Signature Spells for each magic type.

abilities.name: Echoing Strike
abilities.body:
When you make a melee attack, you may spend **1 Spellstrike Point** to make a secondary attack roll with the same rolls as your first, to have your blade echo and strike the target again. If the target is defeated by the initial attack, then Echoing Strike targets an adjacent enemy, or refunds the Spellstrike points spend if there is no valid target.

Echoing Blade is not enchanted nor does it gain bonuses from enchantments. It will however keep Stat and Proficiency bonuses made with the original attack. All damage from Echoing Blade is magical. At Spellblade Levels 6 and 9, Echoing Strike attacks an additional time.

abilities.name: Distant Blade
abilities.body: Spend **1 Spellstrike Point** to give yourself 6m melee Attack Range for your next Full Action attack, or next two Half Action attacks. If you make a single Half Action attack this way, your next Full Action attack won’t gain the range bonus.

abilities.name: Pinpoint Blade
abilities.body: Spend **1 Spellstrike Point** to have your Melee attack hit against **Spell AC** instead of Physical AC. Alternatively, you may also choose to have Melee Spell Attack hit against Physical AC instead of Spell AC. If both AC and Spell ACs are the same, refund the Spellstrike Points.

abilities.name: Doubling Strike
abilities.body: Spend **2 Spellstrike Points** after you cast a Melee Spell to cast the same spell again as an Immediate Action choosing any target within range. This spell costs half Mana rounded down, however does not gain Stat bonuses to Attack or Damage rolls.

abilities.name: Critical Blade
abilities.body: Spend **3 Spellstrike Points** to ensure your next Melee Spell or Enchanted Melee attack is a guaranteed critical hit. This attack cannot miss.

drafts.name: melee spells count as melee attacks
drafts.body: and add proficiency bonus to spell attacks
